say:1:1012608001:1.text: These people saved me and my father. They're heroes!
say:1:1012608001:1.source_cn: 这些人救了我和阿爸，他们是好人！

say:2:1012608002:1.text: I'm sorry I was so rude! I was scared out of my wits just now...
say:2:1012608002:1.source_cn: 真对不起，我刚才是被吓破胆了……所以才失礼的。

say:4:1012608003:0.text: But the look in your eyes just now... *laugh*... You really thought that I was the child of prophecy...
say:4:1012608003:0.source_cn: 不，你刚才的眼神，真的把我当成预言之子似的，哈哈……

say:6:1012608004:2.text: Are you finished laughing? Stop being rude.
say:6:1012608004:2.source_cn: 好啦，笑够了没有，再笑就是你失礼了。

say:7:1012608005:0.text: It's alright. I wanted to believe it was true.
say:7:1012608005:0.source_cn: 没什么，如果预言是好的，我愿意相信。

say:9:1012608006:2.text: Vina, it's great to see that you're alright. I want to check on everyone.
say:9:1012608006:2.source_cn: 维娜，能见到你无事太好了，让我见见大家。

say:10:1012608007:0.text: Many villagers are injured, so Kelvin went out to find herbs. We couldn't stop him.
say:10:1012608007:0.source_cn: 很多村民都负伤了，凯尔温也是急着要去采药草才出去的，我...

say:12:1012608008:0.text: Magister, you should continue going after Eomir.
say:12:1012608008:0.source_cn: 梅林，你带着大家继续追赶伊米尔。
say:12:1012608008:0.male: Magister, you should continue going after Eomir.
say:12:1012608008:0.female: Magister, you should continue going after Eomir.

say:15:1012608010:0.text: There are many corrupted creatures nearby. These villagers can't go out and find herbs like this.
say:15:1012608010:0.source_cn: 附近的魔物还有很多，光靠这些村民是没办法集齐药草的。

say:17:1012608011:0.text: The child of prophecy can't just suddenly leave. What do you think, Magister Merlin?
say:17:1012608011:0.source_cn: 预言之子忽然离开可不太好吧，你说呢？梅林。
say:17:1012608011:0.male: The child of prophecy can't just suddenly leave. What do you think, Magister Merlin?
say:17:1012608011:0.female: The child of prophecy can't just suddenly leave. What do you think, Magister Merlin?

choice_prompt:18:1012608011.text: The child of prophecy can't just suddenly leave. What do you think, Magister Merlin?
choice_prompt:18:1012608011.source_cn: 预言之子忽然离开可不太好吧，你说呢？梅林。
choice_prompt:18:1012608011.male: The child of prophecy can't just suddenly leave. What do you think, Magister Merlin?
choice_prompt:18:1012608011.female: The child of prophecy can't just suddenly leave. What do you think, Magister Merlin?

say:20:1012608012:2.text: We are aware of your haste, Eironn, but this is the best way to keep us from getting separated.
say:20:1012608012:2.source_cn: 埃隆，我们知道你很着急，但以防走散，这样的确是最快的。

say:21:1012608015:0.text: Well... let's set off as soon as possible.

choice:18:0:1.text: We can help them collect herbs.
choice:18:0:1.source_cn: 我们一起采集完再启程
choice:18:0:1.male: We can help them collect herbs.
choice:18:0:1.female: We can help them collect herbs.

say:23:1012608013:2.text: Ha! Yes! Why not? You definitely are a legend, even among Wilders, Magister Merlin.
say:23:1012608013:2.source_cn: 哈，是的！我得承认你才是真正的预言之子！
say:23:1012608013:2.male: Ha! Yes! Why not? You definitely are a legend, even among Wilders, Magister Merlin.
say:23:1012608013:2.female: Ha! Yes! Why not? You definitely are a legend, even among Wilders, Magister Merlin.

say:24:1012608014:2.text: No wonder you two get along so well...
say:24:1012608014:2.source_cn: 呼……怪不得你们私交这么好。

choice:18:1:2.text: I am the child of prophecy!
choice:18:1:2.male: I am the child of prophecy!
choice:18:1:2.female: I am the child of prophecy!
